messages.en: I'm just about to fall asleepㅏ
I took a super quick shower.
I came to tell you that you worked so hard today.
I'm debating whether or not to go to the concert.
Don't worry about it~
We're really working hard.
So please look forward to it a lot.

messages.ko: 새로운곡들도 많으니까 보는 재미거 있지 않을까 싶더
messages.en: There are lots of new songs too, so I think it'll be fun to watch.

messages.ko: 우리는 새로운 곡들 덕분에 뇌용량이 꽉차서
messages.en: Our brains are completely full thanks to all the new songs,
so I think we need to go buy some more tomorrow.
크쿸ㅋ
The members are all trying to make the stage even better,
and they're giving even more of their own ideas,
and each of them is working hard to prepare,
so we're in such a proud tripleS state.
Anyway, before I go to sleep,
I came because I missed you.
You give me strength.
I love you~~
Good night, dream of me.
I'll give you lots of spoilers in your dreams~
No, I'll just dance all of them for you><
I'm typing with my eyes closed.
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋ
I'll go now. Haranghae😍😍
